changed.description: The local check: only what the change risks (D88), on the arches this Mac configures. Not the merge gate.

brimstone.description: The merge gate: vx test --changed amd64 arm64 on brimstone at the branch's last commit (uncommitted changes are not tested). Read build/vx/brimstone/ before reporting a pass. Needs the remote-test skill's lock handling, so never run brimstone by hand.

autopilot.escalate: contradicting an Accepted decision (a D-number); reading sources the clean-room rules restrict; pushing to GitHub origin; merging to main; a failure that 'passed on rerun'; anything that can't be undone
